segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine reconciliation by Codex, reused non-author of both current originals. Letter to a Friend is the established title; its bracketed author is explanatory, with Friend and Letter as its only members. Plural rnams is fused into spirits; source las and two topic ni have no separate English word. Bound 'ang twice has overt even counterparts but no defensible compound parent containing them without supplied wording, so both are omitted, never nulled. The assertion and sensation reprises stay unwrapped. Capital For/In and lowercase causal for retain distinct owners. ILL:2342, physical label [2337], says summer; C05 says spring, positively attested in HTG2016. This difference does not establish a correction. No source wording or hgm_gloss is changed.
